lines.name: Blorb
lines.text: You there. That paddle on your belt is not decoration, is it?

lines.name: Blorb
lines.text: My table has bumpers down the middle. Learn the angles or do not bother. First to three?

lines.name: Blorb
lines.text: Good. Bumpers are live off the break, and I do not call them for you.
lines.label: accepted

lines.name: Blorb
lines.text: Thought so. The table is not going anywhere, and neither am I.
lines.label: declined
